evals.prompt: Review a screen that branches its layout on a manually computed window width.
evals.expected_output: Recommends reading LocalAdaptiveInfo/AppAdaptiveInfo (shared/ui/adaptive) or LocalSenseeAdaptiveLayoutMetrics in the design system instead of ad-hoc width math; flags raw colors/dp in favour of SenseeTheme tokens; does not introduce Material.

evals.prompt: On the web build the screen has no accessibility semantics. Should I turn them on in this UI change?
evals.expected_output: Notes IS_WEB_ACCESSIBILITY_ENABLED=false is a deliberate Compose Multiplatform workaround, not a defect to fix here; keeps focus/roles/touch-target review for supported targets; suggests the design-system/app-shell module checks.
